summary: Round 10, frontend only. Tested the driver-app dark mode that follows the phone setting, the clearer driver-app light mode, and the dashboard gray-400 to gray-500 change. Driver app at 390x844 with Playwright prefers-color-scheme dark: Home, Start Trip (all 5 steps, photos sent through the web file chooser, geolocation granted), Active Trip, End Trip, StopsCard and the PendingTrips card all have dark backgrounds, a dark header (#131c2e) and no white cards. Body and secondary text contrast is 7.8 to 17 (textMuted #a3b1c6 is 7.83 on cards and 8.61 on the page background). Inputs are readable and the dark placeholder #7c8aa0 is about 4.9 on the card colour. The StopsCard Navigate button is inverted (#e2e8f0 background, #0f172a text, 14.48 contrast, 48 px tall). I've arrived is 9.54, the too-far error text is 8.97, and the Google Maps, Waze and Cancel options are 7.8 to 15.5. PendingTrips is 10.43 dark and 6.84 light. Switching the OS scheme live, with no reload, re-themes the app at once. Light mode: secondary text is now #55657a, at 5.69 on the page background and 5.95 on cards; the light placeholder #64748b is 4.76. Login, forgot and reset screens stay dark in both modes, unchanged. Full trip regression as james@fleet.com passed in dark mode: 5 steps, then Active Trip with a running timer, then End Trip, then Home showing 'Trip completed successfully!' and the new row. An offline trip (start and end with /api/trips blocked) showed the pending notice, then the PendingTrips card; 'Send now' synced it and both trips are completed in the DB. Dashboard light: .text-gray-400 renders rgb(100,116,139), 4.76 on white, for Stops 'Last seen' and Drivers 'Next stop'. Dashboard dark: rgb(139,154,176) on rgb(19,28,46), 5.96. Stops board live expiry: a live point was backdated to 130 s old and the page left open. The label read 'Live · 10:08 PM' and turned into 'Last seen 10:08 PM' about 67 s after load with no reload, so the new 30 s interval works. Remaining issues are contrast problems on coloured buttons: white on the dark-mode primary #3b82f6 is 3.68, the duration label is 2.04 dark and 2.87 light, the red End Trip and green Complete Trip buttons are about 3.77 in both modes, and in light mode Logout is 3.6 and the disabled 'End Current Trip First' button is 1.8. Deprecated packages detected: none (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

design_issues.screen: Driver app, dark mode (Home, Start Trip, StopsCard badge, Active Trip)
issues: Dark palette primary #3b82f6 with #fff text gives 3.68 (< 4.5 for 17px bold). Affected: '+ Start New Trip' (home-start-trip-button), 'Next' and 'Start Trip' (start-step-next, start-trip-submit), the next-stop badge number in StopsCard, and the duration value (44px, passes 3:1 for large text only). Fix: set dark primary to #2563eb (5.17 with white) or use a darker text colour. Reference: /app/driver-app/src/theme.ts:42
durationLabel is hardcoded #93c5fd on the primary background: 2.04 in dark, 2.87 in light. Use e.g. rgba(255,255,255,0.85) or #dbeafe. Reference: /app/driver-app/src/screens/ActiveTripScreen.tsx:116

design_issues.screen: Active Trip / End Trip buttons (both modes, pre-existing)
issues: End Trip: #fff on #ef4444 is 3.76 (active-trip-end-button). Use #dc2626, which gives 4.83. Reference: ActiveTripScreen.tsx:118
Complete Trip: #fff on #059669 is 3.77 (end-trip-submit). Use #047857, which gives 5.48. Reference: EndTripScreen.tsx:162
Logout text #ef4444 on #f8fafc is 3.6 (home-logout-button). Use c.dangerText: #b91c1c light (about 6.4) and #fca5a5 dark. Reference: HomeScreen.tsx:240

Disabled 'End Current Trip First' is white on primaryDisabled #93c5fd, contrast 1.8, and this text explains why the button is unavailable. Use a darker text colour on the disabled button (e.g. c.primaryText) or a darker disabled background. Reference: theme.ts:15, HomeScreen.tsx:251-252
The Logout touch target is plain text with no padding or hitSlop, so it is probably below 44 px tall. Add hitSlop or padding.
Minor, pre-existing: the input placeholder rgba(255,255,255,0.35) is 2.82 contrast. Use about 0.55 alpha for 4.5. Reference: LoginScreen.tsx placeholderTextColor

action_items: Fix the dark primary button contrast: theme.ts dark.primary #3b82f6 with white text is 3.68. Use #2563eb, or keep #3b82f6 and use a dark text colour.
ActiveTripScreen durationLabel: replace the hardcoded #93c5fd (2.04 dark, 2.87 light) with a lighter tint such as rgba(255,255,255,0.85).
Darken the End Trip red (#ef4444 to #dc2626) and the Complete Trip green (#059669 to #047857) so white text passes 4.5.
Home Logout: use c.dangerText instead of #ef4444 (3.6 in light) and add hitSlop or padding so the tap target is at least 44 px.
Light-mode disabled 'End Current Trip First' (white on #93c5fd, 1.8): use a readable text or background combination.
Optional: App.tsx:46 picks the navigation theme with c.bg === '#f8fafc', which is brittle. Use useColorScheme() === 'dark' instead.
critical_code_review_comments: theme.ts: the useColors and useStyles pattern is clean. useMemo is keyed on the palette object and makeStyles is module-level, so styles only rebuild when the scheme changes.
App.tsx:46 decides the theme by comparing c.bg to a hex string; changing a light colour later would silently break NavigationContainer theming.

Several screens still hardcode colours that skip the palette: '#93c5fd' (ActiveTrip durationLabel), '#ef4444' (Home logout, End Trip), '#059669', '#16a34a', '#22c55e'. These are the main source of the remaining contrast failures.

Dashboard index.css:85 globally remaps .text-gray-400 to --gray-500. It gives 4.76 on white but only about 4.55 on bg-gray-50 (248,250,252), so there is little margin. It also darkens any icon or decorative use of text-gray-400. This is acceptable, but keep it in mind.
react-native-web warns that 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents is deprecated. This is web-only noise and not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 92% - all requested flows pass; the remaining failures are contrast problems on coloured buttons (dark primary, duration label, red and green action buttons, light Logout and disabled button)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Driver app web testing: grant geolocation (context.grant_permissions(['geolocation'], origin=preview) plus set_geolocation) or Start Trip silently fails, because Alert is a no-op on web. Photos: use page.expect_file_chooser() on the photo testIDs and set_files with a png. Dark mode: page.emulate_media(color_scheme='dark'); switching it live re-themes the app. An offline queue can be simulated with page.route('**/api/trips**', abort('internetdisconnected')), and 'Send now' (pending-trips-send-now) flushes it after unroute. Stops for James: python3 /app/test_reports/regression/stops_seed_round10.py [clear]. Live label: python3 /app/test_reports/regression/live_point_round10.py '130 seconds', then open /api/dashboard/stops; the label flips within about 60-70 s. The dashboard dist being served is index-CHTljiL5.js / index-CoTrPgpW.css (built 22:03 with the correct --base). Not verified: StopsCard 'I've arrived' success path in the browser. After set_geolocation moved near the stop, the second tap still reported the old 3432 km distance, probably a cached position in expo-location on web or Playwright; arrival was covered by API tests in earlier rounds.
